name: carrierpay
description: CarrierPay — role-based transportation operations, payroll calculation, approval, and paystub application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @carrierpay/api" "npm run dev -w @carrierpay/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @carrierpay/shared && npm run build -w @carrierpay/api && npm run build -w @carrierpay/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @carrierpay/shared && npm run typecheck -w @carrierpay/api && npm run typecheck -w @carrierpay/web
